function.name: exec
function.description: Run a bounded Bash command on the host as the current user. Relative cwd defaults to the launch workspace. Its child processes are stopped on completion, timeout or cancellation. Use start_process for a persistent service or interactive CLI.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a bounded UTF-8 slice of a regular host file. Relative paths use the launch workspace; absolute paths and symlinks use normal host permissions.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write or append UTF-8 text to a regular host file. Relative paths use the launch workspace. Creates missing parent directories.

function.name: start_process
function.description: Start a host service or interactive program and return its process_id. It survives turns and compaction in this live CLI session. Set tty=true for a terminal. Processes stop on CLI exit and are not restored on conversation resume.

function.name: poll_process
function.description: Read new bounded output and status for a process_id. Optionally wait up to 10 seconds. A missing process_id lists this live session's process handles.

function.name: write_process
function.description: Send UTF-8 input to a live process, including newlines or terminal control characters. Set close_stdin=true to close pipe input; for a terminal send the appropriate EOF character.

function.name: stop_process
function.description: Stop a process and its descendants, then return remaining output and status. Stops only the selected process handle owned by this CLI session.
